prompt:
A long-distance runner maintains an average speed of $21,648$ yards per hour during a training session. What is this average speed, in miles per hour? $( 1 mile = 1,760 yards )$

$$0$$

$$12.3,12.30$$
explanation: The correct answer is $12.3$. It's given that a long-distance runner maintains an average speed of $21{,}648$ yards per hour and $1 \text{ mile} = 1{,}760 \text{ yards}$. It follows that this average speed is equivalent to $\left( \frac{21{,}648 \text{ yards}}{1 \text{ hour}} \right) \left( \frac{1 \text{ mile}}{1{,}760 \text{ yards}} \right)$, which yields $\frac{12.3 \text{ miles}}{1 \text{ hour}}$, or $12.3$ miles per hour. Note that 12.3 and 12.30 are examples of ways to enter a correct answer.
